content.comment_body: Hello! I am trying to configure a [product_name] module but cannot select my hardware type. The system reports that the [article_no]/R Input version is not supported. I do not use this input, so the error is unclear to me.

Resources utilized: Function Blocks 17/400, REM 0/250, Digital Inputs 3/24, Digital Outputs 4/20, Flags 4/64, Analog Inputs 0/8, Text Box 0/50, Text Contents 0/50, Analog Outputs 0/8, Program Memory 200/8500, Block Names 0/100, Analog Flags 0/64, Cursor Keys 0/4, Shift Register 0/4, Shift Register Bits 0/32, Open Connectors 0/64, [product_name] TD Function Keys 0/4, Network Inputs 0/64, Network Analog Inputs 0/32, UDF Types 0/16, UDF Instances 0/64, Data Log 0/1, Network Outputs 0/64, Network Analog Outputs 0/16, Analog Filters 0/8.
The hardware information appears to be for a different module ([article_no]), not the one you mentioned. Have you checked that the hardware type selected matches your device?
Regarding the topic: On earlier [product_name] modules, inverting a digital signal required using the "NOT" instruction, which would use an additional logic block.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble configuring a [product_name] module, facing issues with hardware selection and receiving unclear error messages about input version compatibility.
